floorPlans.label: Emaar: Lyvia by Palace full floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Review the one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside the three-bedroom townhouse. Complete sheets retain every unit-group table, key plan, building section, room drawing and developer notice; the townhouse page shows all three levels together.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Lyvia apartment or townhouse layout
floorPlans.note: Total area includes balcony or terrace space. Where a sheet gives two unit-group totals, both are shown as a range. The shared TH01–09 plan prints 3,238.11 sq ft; the fact sheet’s 3,238–3,245 sq ft range does not establish a larger area for every townhouse. Request the exact signed unit plan, specifications and service terms from Emaar.
